recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If FHIR-52952 or a future work-group decision reverses deprecation or naming, handle that follow-up in the FHIR Extension Pack and related validator/package behavior rather than changing current core source for FHIR-25039.
issue_request: FHIR-25039 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to replace the opaque iso21090 PQ translation extension/page name with the clearer extension-quantity-translation name.
initial_application: Core commit 2c73520c8c81929f80262da3e04d669c71abcf32 applied the rename in the extension spreadsheets, moving the old PQ-translation row to extension-quantity-translation with QuantityTranslation/Quantity Translation labels. Later core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension rows from the R5 core source.
additional_context: Current core source no longer contains the extension StructureDefinition or stale old canonical references; the only matching core source hit is source/oids.ini for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/extension-quantity-translation. The Extension Pack contains the active renamed StructureDefinition and a retired iso21090-PQ-translation StructureDefinition pointing to the renamed canonical as replacement. FHIR-52952 later questions deprecation/reversal, but it is Submitted in FHIR-extensions and does not supersede this Published core issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current core checkout has no source correction to make and the current Extension Pack source already reflects the accepted rename relationship.

related_jiras.note: Submitted FHIR-extensions issue asking to revert or undeprecate iso21090 extensions; relevant future context but not a final decision for this core reconciliation.
